programs.title: The Outrun
programs.desc: A young woman named Rona (Saoirse Ronan), who has recently left an addiction treatment center, returns from London to her native Scotland, to one of the islands of the Orkney archipelago.Because her parents are separated, she lives alternately with her mother, where she meets with her religious friends, and with her father, whom she helps on the farm.At the same time, she is still trying to cope with difficult memories - the beginning of her stay in London, where she started studying biology and often went to clubs with her boyfriend Daynin (Paapa Essiedu).She didn't even notice when she fell into alcoholism, which led to problems in her relationship and began to destroy her life.Meanwhile, while staying on the island, Rona decides to return to London.However, already on the ferry he feels that he is unable to control the urge to drink alcohol.He must re-plan his life.

programs.title: Last Swim
programs.desc: Ziba (Deba Hekmat), whose family comes from Iran, lives in London and is an ambitious young woman.However, she hides a painful secret that none of her friends know about.Ziba has just gotten into university, where she is going to study astrophysics.On this occasion, he meets with his friends: Tara (Lydia Fleming), Shea (Solly McLeod) and Merf (Jay Lycurgo), with whom he intends to celebrate this event.She feels irritated when she learns that they are to be joined by a promising young football player, Malcolm (Denzel Baidoo), whom she does not know.Soon, however, an event occurs that makes him emotionally closer to her than her long-time friends.The future for both of them is not as bright as it might seem.Sasha Nathwani's feature-length directorial debut.

programs.title: Dope Girls
programs.sub_title: A Filthy Little Mole Down a Filthy Little Hole
programs.desc: A widowed single mother, Kate is perceived by those around her as a calm person with conservative views.To provide for his family, he decides to take a surprising step - he opens a nightclub.

programs.title: Killer Heat
programs.desc: Greece.American Nick Bali (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) is hired to investigate the circumstances of the death of young shipping magnate Leo Vardakis (Richard Madden) in Crete.The deceased's sister-in-law, Penelope Vardakis (Shailene Woodley), does not believe the official police report.A private detective discovers that sunny landscapes hide many dark secrets and anyone can be a suspect.He discovers further facts about the rich and influential Vardakis family, as well as the brothers' complicated relationship.Adaptation of the story "The Jealousy Man" by Jo Nesbo.

programs.title: Neuilly-Poissy
programs.desc: Daniel (Max Boublil) is a successful entrepreneur.He successfully combines running a business with a successful family life.However, when financial irregularities are discovered in his company, he is forced to exchange a luxurious apartment in the city of Neuilly for a cell in the prison in Poissy.From one day to the next, he finds himself in a world whose rules he does not understand.Moreover, he is a Jew and now he will be hanging out with Muslims.However, thanks to his sense of humor and the ability to cope with difficult situations, Daniel tries to adapt to the new reality.

programs.title: Wunderschöner
programs.desc: 50-year-old Nadine (Anneke Kim Sarnau) does everything to look young.When she discovers that her husband (Godehard Giese) is cheating on her, she falls into depression.The couple's daughter Lilly (Emilia Packard) is interested in the classes lectured by feminist Vicky (Nora Tschirner).Enno, the narrator's boyfriend, participates in the project of her new colleague Trevor (Malick Bauer).He doesn't know that his beloved will soon lose her head for him.Julie (Emilia Schüle), a new TV production manager, suffers from loneliness.Her difficult relationship with her co-worker increases her doubts about herself.Sonja (Karoline Herfurth) and Milan (Friedrich Mücke) go to family therapy.When it comes to light that the man has a new partner, the woman starts dating.

programs.title: L'amica geniale
programs.desc:
Elena Greco is an elderly woman who tries to solve the mystery of the disappearance of her friend - Raffaella Ceruullo, who was called Lila.The women met in their early youth - in 1950, when they attended primary school.The old woman recalls her early years.The action of the series takes place in dangerous and charming Naples and spans 60 years.The story of their relationship is unconventional, because although Lila was Elena's best friend and confidant, she was also her enemy.The series is an adaptation of the novel by Elena Ferrante
It looks like the Cerullo family is on the verge of bankruptcy because the shoes are not selling well.Fernando and his future son-in-law want to save the plant and ask the wealthy Solara family for financial support.Additional funds would enable them to distribute better.The Solars agree to help, but with one condition: Silvio is to be a witness at Lila's wedding.The future bride does not want to let this happen, but Elena intervenes and the couple agrees that Silvio can act as a witness, as long as Marcello does not come to the wedding.Nino asks Elena to write an article, but it is not published, leaving her disappointed.Marcello suddenly appears at Lili and Stefano's party.The bride realizes that her rejected lover has come to humiliate her.

programs.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programs.desc: Teenage Peter Parker is raised by his uncle Ben and his wife May.The boy has a crush on his schoolmate, Gwen.He tries at all costs to find out what happened to his parents.The folder his father Richard left him leads him to Dr. Curt Connors.This former colleague of Richard's doesn't want to tell Peter a secret about his family.Soon the teenager is bitten by a spider with modified DNA.In an instant, he turns into Spider-Man with supernatural abilities.Then Connors reveals his other side.As the Lizard, he becomes Spider Man's greatest enemy.

programs.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programs.desc: Young Peter Parker (Andrew Garfield) tries to reconcile the responsibilities of an average student with the challenges of being a superhero.As a human, the spider protects representatives of humanity from evil.Remembering a promise he once made to his girlfriend's father, he breaks up with his beloved Gwen (Emma Stone).It soon turns out that the city's inhabitants are in danger from Electro (Jamie Foxx), a living energy generator.Meanwhile, Harry Osborne (Dane DeHaan), Peter's childhood friend, continues the secret project of his late father, the head of Oscorp, that threatens humanity.Seriously ill, he becomes convinced that only a transfusion of blood from Spider-Man will save him.

actor: Green Goblin / Harry Osborn - Dane DeHaan

programs.title: Queen Of The Ring
programs.desc: 1930s.Single mother Mildred Bliss (Emily Bett Rickards), who has always been interested in sports, dreams of becoming a wrestler.When she meets the promoter of this sport, Billy Wolfe (Josh Lucas), she decides to try her hand at this discipline, although it belongs entirely to men and the law prohibits women from entering the ring.It quickly turns out that he can cope very well, even with players who are more powerful than himself.Billy becomes her manager and lover, and soon her husband.The increasingly successful woman adopts the pseudonym Mildred Burke and over time becomes the first millionaire wrestling professional.Unfortunately, her successes in the ring do not go hand in hand with a successful personal life.First of all, her marriage is not a happy one.Based on a true story about the life of women's wrestling pioneer Mildred Burke.

programs.title: Insecure 2
programs.desc: A story about lost twenty-year-olds, viewers observe their friendships, difficult experiences, joys and sorrows.The main character is Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a shy African American who lives in Los Angeles.Her life is not a bed of roses.She suffers numerous humiliations, which affect her lack of self-confidence.The girl tries to live according to her own rules, regardless of conventions.Despite his poor financial situation and problems at work, he does not lose his cheerful spirit.She shares her problems with her best friend, a self-centered lawyer named Molly (Yvonne Orji).The series was nominated for a Golden Globe.Issa Rea is not only the main actress, but also the producer and originator of the series.The actress rose to fame through the website "The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl" and the YouTube website.
